value: semilethal temperature (LT50, 50% membrane leakage) -23.71 C in seedlings of this perennial herb
method: controlled-freezing series with electrolyte-leakage LT50 (logistic fit)
conditions: seedlings cooled at 5 C/h from 25 C to -5, -15, -25 and -35 C, each held 12 h and returned at the same rate after 7 d acclimation at 25/18 C; three plants per species and treatment; LT50 is the inflection of a logistic fit of relative electrical conductivity (membrane leakage) against temperature; the Results give the species ranking and the values sit in the Discussion; the paper's integrated multi-trait cold-tolerance index ranked the species in a different order (A. vestita > A. lanceolatus > V. negundo > R. hastatus > S. davidii), so LT50 alone does not rank tolerance; seedling age and number are not defined

note: Full text read on frontiersin.org (pdf, three passes); licence statement on the page: CC BY (Crossref CC BY 4.0).
